# Legal Risk Management and AML Review

This confidential bank document outlines critical tasks for the Risk & Compliance department.

Key areas of focus include:

*   Reviewing the internal control standard update.
*   Investigating Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection for Strategy 2026.
*   Monitoring legal risks on a quarterly basis.
*   Updating legal risks based on audit recommendations.
*   Optimizing legal risks in alignment with Strategy 2026 objectives.
